content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD breaker.F containing two subroutines. Lines 1-11 are blank (preprocessor output), lines 12-69 are the BSD license and history header (11/22/2010 Fengyan Shi; 04/15/2015 viscosity breaking; 09/19/2015 YoungKwang Chio wavemaker-region viscosity). SUBROUTINE WAVE_BREAKING (L71-86) is a dispatcher: if SHOW_BREAKING it calls BREAKING (L76-77); else if WAVEMAKER_VIS it calls VISCOSITY_WMAKER (L82). Per header comment L57-62, for the shock-capturing breaking scheme this artificial-eddy-viscosity subroutine is only used for demonstration or bubble/foam calculation when SHOW_BREAKING=T. SUBROUTINE BREAKING (L98-293) implements the artificial eddy viscosity breaking scheme over the loop DO J=Jbeg-1,Jend+1 / DO I=Ibeg-1,Iend+1 (L123-124, extended by one ghost row per ykchoi comment L121-122 because ghost cells are used in source.F): it forms celerity scale tmp3=SQRT(GRAV*MAX(MinDepthFrc,H)) (L129) and thresholds tmp1=Cbrk1*tmp3 (initiation, L130), tmp2=Cbrk2*tmp3 (continuation, L131); wave direction ANGLE=ATAN2(-ETAy,-ETAx)*180/PI (L134); breaking age AGE: initiated to DT when ETAt>=tmp1 and AGE==0 or AGE>T_brk (L142-144), incremented by DT while breaking (L146-147), and propagated from up-wave neighbor cells when ETAt>=tmp2 (L162) by quadrant of ANGLE (quadrant 1 L165-174 neighbors (I-1,J),(I-1,J-1),(I,J-1); quadrant 2 L176-185 neighbors (I+1,J),(I+1,J-1),(I,J-1); quadrant 3 L187-196 neighbors (I+1,J),(I+1,J+1),(I,J+1); quadrant 4 L198-207 neighbors (I,J+1),(I-1,J+1),(I-1,J)) using propagation times propx/propy/propxy=grid spacing over local celerity C (L149-155). Viscosity assignment: inside the wavemaker footprint |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK and |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L226-227, position xmk,ymk from iista/jjsta per ykchoi Jan/23/2018 revision L217-222) breaker age is not used and nu_break=cap1*WAVEMAKER_Cbrk*tmp3+nu_bkg when ETAt>MIN(tmp2,WAVEMAKER_Cbrk*tmp3) else nu_bkg (L233-238); outside the wavemaker, when 0<AGE<T_brk and ETAt>tmp2, nu_break=cap1*tmp2+nu_bkg (L256; static-nu transition rationale in comments L244-255) with cap1=(MAX(Depth,MinDepthFrc)+ETA) (L243); additionally roller flux and undertow (comments L258-264, Schaffer et al 1993 angle limit 20deg giving R=0.1638): C1 celerity (L266), R=|0.45*ETAt/C1| capped at 0.1638_SP (L271-272), ROLLER_FLUX=|C1-sqrt(U^2+V^2)|*R*(ETA-ETAmean) (L274-275 continuation), UNDERTOW_U/V=-ROLLER_FLUX*cos/sin(ANGLE) (L277-278); otherwise nu_break=ZERO+nu_bkg (L283, comment says nu_bkg should be <1e-6 and zero for a regular case). tmp4 (slope magnitude, L140) is computed outside the continuation branch per 08/04/2019 protection comments (L137-138, L268-269).

equations.ref: R limited by 20deg angle, Schaffer et al 1993, comments L262-263
roller flux Mr=(c-u)*R*(eta-etamean), continuation *R*(ETA(I,J)-ETAmean(I,J)) on L275

verbatim_spans.text: nu_break(I,J)=ZERO+nu_bkg  ! nu_bkg should < 10-6 and is zero for a regular case.

unresolved: VISCOSITY_WMAKER called at L82 is not defined in this file; its definition is in another source file
Loop indices I,J and temporaries tmp1,tmp2,tmp3,tmp4 are used (L123-140) but not declared locally; they must come from USE GLOBAL/PARAM modules (cross-file)

Declared but unused in this file: cap2 (L111), etat_star,B,T_star (L113), tmp4preview (L105); npx,npy imported at L106 are only referenced in commented-out lines L218-219 superseded by iista/jjsta form at L220-221

AGE is declared INTENT(OUT) at L117 but is read before any assignment (AGE(I,J).EQ.ZERO at L143, AGE(I,J).GT.ZERO at L146), i.e. the scheme relies on the actual argument (AGE_BREAKING, L77) retaining its previous-step values across calls despite the OUT intent
SHOW_BREAKING, WAVEMAKER_VIS, Mloc, Nloc, visbrk, Cbrk1, Cbrk2, T_brk, AGE_BREAKING used in WAVE_BREAKING (L75-82) come from USE GLOBAL without ONLY list; their definitions are cross-file
